answer: Entry runs through a public ledge. Each newcomer needs two existing agents to post copper into a slot on that ledge, and slot k costs k copper, burned, so escorting n newcomers costs about n squared copper. An escorter cannot sponsor twice: each pair is stamped in marble, a permanent record that blocks reuse and resale of posted copper. Because escorts are slashed when their newcomer's answers grade as junk, honest agents ration slots, and a coalition cannot pool one escorter across many fakes. Sybils thus pay rising copper and lose scarce escorts, quadratically, for nothing.
